import json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(gin):
    n=len(gin); D=[gin[k][k] for k in range(n)]
    s=next(k for k in range(n) if D[k]!=0)  # skip leading zeros on diagonal
    p=n-s
    def Dp(v): return D[s+v%p]
    return [[Dp(max(i,j)) for j in range(2*n)] for i in range(2*n)]
for key in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    print(key, f(G[key+' input'])==G[key+' output'])
out=f(G['Test input'])
print(json.dumps(out))

def load():
    import os,re
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

I=np.array(G['Demo pair 1 input']); O=np.array(G['Demo pair 1 output'])
I2=np.array(G['Demo pair 2 input']); O2=np.array(G['Demo pair 2 output'])
def f(inp):
    inp=np.array(inp); h,w=inp.shape
    nz=np.argwhere(inp!=0)
    rs,cz=nz[:,0].min(),nz[:,1].min(); RH=len(nz[nz[:,0]==rs])-0
    # bbox of nonzero region
    r0,c0=nr_.min() if False else (nz[:,0].min(),nz[:,1].min())
    r1,c1=nz[:,0].max(),nz[:,1].max()
    B=inp[r0:r1+1,c0:c1+1]; bh,bw=B.shape
    D=[B[min(k,bh-1)][min(k,bw-1)] for k in range(max(bh,bw))]
    out=[[0]*(2*w) for _ in range(2*h)]
    for r in range(2*h):
        for c in range(2*w):
            rr,cc=(r-r0)%(bh if True else bh),(c-c0)%(bw)
            v=B[rr][cc]
            out[r][c]=v if v else D[max(rr,cc)%len(D)]
    return out
print('d1:',f(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
print('d2:',f(G['Demo pair 2 input'])==G['Demo pair 2 output'])
print(np.array(f(G['Test input'])).shape)

import numpy as np, json
def load():
    import os,re
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

C4=list(dict.fromkeys(I4[i,i] for i in range(7)))
q4=np.array([[C4[(max(r,c))%7] for c in range(14)] for r in range(14)])

import numpy as np, os, re
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')

for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

    I=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {i} input']); O=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {i} output'])
    H,W=I.shape; oh,ow=O.shape
    ext=np.tile(I,(2,2))
    e=ext[:oh,:ow]; err=int(np.sum(e!=O))
    ok = err==0
    ok_all &= ok
    print(i,'tile2 error:',err, 'exact:' if err==0 else '')
print('ALL EXACT TILED INPUT?' , ok_all)
